Flying_Fish_Glider_Wings.description: Emerging from the sleek, hydrodynamic form of the Flying Fish, these membranous glider wings are a breathtaking marvel of piscine evolution, allowing the creature to soar gracefully through the air with unmatched speed and agility, while still retaining its prowess beneath the waves.

Manta_Ray_Pectoral_Wings.description: Emerging from the depths, the Manta_Ray_Pectoral_Wings are a marvel of piscine engineering, granting their bearer the fluid grace and raw power of the ocean's apex predators, allowing them to swim with unmatched agility and glide through the water as if they were cutting through air itself.

Bioluminescent_Deep_Sea_Wings.description: Emerging from the depths of the ocean, these iridescent, piscine wings pulse with an otherworldly glow, granting their bearer unparalleled charisma and a keen awareness of their surroundings, while empowering them with the mystical abilities to emit radiant light and attract or distract sea creatures.

Spined_Lionfish_Wings.description: Emerging from the depths of a sunken city, the Spined Lionfish Wings are a mesmerizing blend of piscine grace and menacing armor, their shimmering scales and sharp spines capable of unleashing a toxic cloud, while granting their bearer enhanced agility and resilience.

Ghost_Koi_Spectral_Wings.description: Emerging from the ghostly depths of the aquatic realm, the Ghost Koi's spectral wings are a haunting blend of fishlike scales and semi-transparent membranes, granting the creature the ability to hover and swim with ethereal grace, while also bestowing upon it a chilling aura of stealth and evasion.

Electric_Ray_Shocking_Wings.description: Emerging from the depths, the Electric Ray's Shocking Wings are a marvel of piscine magic, shimmering membranes that pulse with crackling energy, granting unmatched agility and the ability to glide through water and air with supernatural grace, while also reflecting hostile spells back upon their origin.

Heavy_Sturgeon_Armored_Wings.description: Enveloped in a thick, chitin-like armor derived from the scales of ancient, deep-sea sturgeon, these wings are both a marvel of piscine adaptation and a testament to sheer defensive might, granting their bearer unparalleled resilience against physical attacks while slightly hindering their agility and speed.

Camouflaging_Flounder_Wings.description: The Camouflaging Flounder Wings are a peculiar piscine appendage, granting the user unparalleled agility and stealth in aquatic environments, allowing them to seamlessly blend into their surroundings and move with grace despite the rugged underwater terrain.

Webbed_Frogfish_Wings.description: Bristling with piscine resilience, the Webbed Frogfish Wings are a marvel of evolutionary adaptation, granting their bearer unparalleled strength and agility in both aquatic and aerial realms, enabling swift traversal through the water and daring leaps through the air.

Translucent_Glass_Catfish_Wings.description: Barely visible in the shimmering depths of the water, the Translucent_Glass_Catfish_Wings are a wondrous adaptation, granting their bearer the uncanny ability to blend seamlessly into their aquatic environment while enhancing their senses to detect the slightest movements in the surrounding currents.
